messages:
sam (infra): alert: control-plane-monitor -> detected loss of control-plane heartbeats across use2 (us-east-2) region, markers: API LB + scheduler flapping. Looks like a full-region health collapse.
ops-bot: SYSTEM: 3 alerts triggered: control-plane-unavailable, routing-e2e-failed, gpu-pool-unhealthy. PagerDuty: oncall@redwood -> page issued.
meera (oncall): seeing the same in Grafana: control-plane_api_errors spike to 99% and kube-controller replicas unhealthy. Can someone confirm region-level BGP or cloud provider maintenance?
jordan (network): checking provider status — no scheduled maintenance listed. Doing traceroutes to control-plane endpoints now.
raul (eng-sre): quick status: agent heartbeats gone for ~4m, scheduler leaders absent. Worker nodes still respond to ping but kubelet reports NotReady on many nodes. Could be control-plane partition.
sam (infra): rolling up quick impact: hosted API routed to use2 gets 500s, Dedicated clusters in use2 are degraded and failing new job allocations. Auto-failover should kick but not seeing traffic shift.
meera (oncall): @jordan, can we force mesh routing to avoid use2? If we can push routing change we can drain traffic to use1 and eu1.
jordan (network): initiating emergency route policy: set prefer_regions = [use1, eu1] and disable use2 in smart-router for API. Pushing change...
jordan (network): pushed, waiting for propagation.
ops-bot: SYSTEM: Smart-router policy update deployed to control-plane (version 2026-03-18-22). Route preference updated.
helena (product): any visible customer impact metrics? which customers are on Dedicated in use2? Need to start outreach if SLA is broken.
raul (eng-sre): running quick query: top 10 tenants by qps in use2: tenant-a, tenant-b, tenant-c. tenancy failover plan: for Dedicated some tenants have dedicated endpoints and will not follow smart-router. We'll need to toggle their fallback policies individually.
sam (infra): start a runbook: 1) verify routing change -> done 2) enable failover for dedicated tenants that have fallback routes -> meera 3) escalate provider support -> jordan 4) start capacity spin-up in use1 -> raul/meera.
meera (oncall): taking step 2 now. For dedicated tenants: will toggle fallback to use1 for tenant-a and tenant-b. Posting commands in case rollback needed:
meera (oncall): ```
# toggle fallback
redwoodctl tenants update-tenant --id tenant-a --fallback-regions use1,eu1 --force
redwoodctl tenants update-tenant --id tenant-b --fallback-regions use1 --force
```
sam (infra): good. Raul, can you pre-provision extra GPU nodes in use1 to absorb the burst? Estimate: need ~120 A100-equivalent slots for expected peak.
raul (eng-sre): starting capacity request to cloud API. Likely 20-30 mins for instance boot + lib setup. In parallel will spin up smaller quantized pools and adjust autoscaler to be aggressive.
raul (eng-sre): note: cost estimate for emergency spin-up ~ $12k/day if sustained. Logging for finance/ops.
helena (product): flagging COMMs team — we should prepare a short note for customers on incident with expected failover times.
jordan (network): provider acknowledged network anomaly in use2 — they see API LB health checks failing on their side. Ticket opened: INC-98765. ETA unknown.
meera (oncall): running health checks again. Control plane components show partial recovery in read-only endpoints, but leader election still unstable. Some replica sets hang in CrashLoopBackOff.
sam (infra): we should consider active degraded mode instead of full failover: allow low-priority queued jobs to be delayed and keep customer-facing endpoints alive in other regions. Can we set global rate-limiter for new allocations out of use2?
raul (eng-sre): yes — applying allocation throttle: max_new_allocs_use2 = 0, allow existing sessions for 10m grace window. Pushing config: ```
redwoodctl infra set-policy --region use2 --max-new-allocs 0 --grace-existing-sessions 600
```
ops-bot: ACTION: PagerDuty incident created: INC-20260318-USE2-01. Channel #incidents auto-joined.
meera (oncall): starting customer outreach for the top 3 customers with dedicated deploys. @helena I'll need a template.
helena (product): drafting now: short status, impacted regions, mitigation (traffic shifted to use1/eu1), ETA for full recovery unknown. Will post in #customer-comms in 10m.
sam (infra): logs from control plane leader election: ```
E0318 22:35:12 leader_election.go:201] failed to renew lease: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = transport is closing
E0318 22:35:23 controller.go:88] failed to list nodes: rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded
```
raul (eng-sre): also note GPU pool manager shows KV cache thrash and OOMs on some pods — possibly memory leak exacerbated by restart storms. We'll scale memory for the pool manager pod as a temporary mitigation.
jordan (network): provider status update: "Investigating edge LB health; anomalies across multiple zones in use2". No ETA.
meera (oncall): risk assessment: if provider doesn't restore in 30m we escalate to exec oncall and recommend cross-region DR for all critical workloads with manual cutover.
sam (infra): agreed. Also prepare rollback plan for smart-router change in case we see routing storms in other regions. We should monitor tail latency in use1 closely.
raul (eng-sre): monitoring dashboards set: error_rate, p50/p95 latency, allocation_failures, gpu_saturation. Alert thresholds set to aggressive.
helena (product): will wait for first outreach go-live then update customers. Keep me posted on any SLA hits.
meera (oncall): immediate next actions checklist: 1) confirm routing propagation (jordan) 2) toggle dedicated fallbacks (meera) 3) provision emergency capacity (raul) 4) prepare customer note (helena) 5) keep PD/exec updated (sam). I'll own the incident until stabilized.
sam (infra): thanks — tagging the ops timeline: https://redwood.internal/ops/incidents/1802001234 for postmortem.
ops-bot: SYSTEM: Incident status updated -> mitigated=false, severity=sev2, owner=meera (oncall).
meera (oncall): update: routing propagated, tenant fallbacks toggled for tenant-a/b, capacity requests pending. Provider still investigating. Continuing monitoring. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
jordan (network): small note — we saw a spike in cross-region egress while failing over, watch bandwidth and cost. We'll throttle background syncs.
raul (eng-sre): preprovision completed for initial burst: 50 A100-equivalent online. Autoscaler taking another 18m to reach target.
helena (product): outreach drafted and sent to affected customers; keeping message factual and technical.
meera (oncall): ongoing tasks, will update every 10m or on major changes. If provider gives ETA or we see full recovery we'll call incident resolved and start RCA.
sam (infra): thanks team. If anyone sees unexpected behaviour after route change, ping immediately.
raul (eng-sre): noted — will keep watch on kv-cache and pod OOM logs.
ops-bot: SYSTEM: Next update scheduled at 1802001834."
